title: Doctorant.e: Quantification des pesticides dans les dépôts atmosphériques : Origine et Variabilité CDD 36 mois à IMT Nord Europe
description:
Unité : CERI EE (IMT NE) et Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie l'Environnement et la Santé (ICPEES, UMR 7515 CNRS, Université de Strasbourg)
Responsable hiérarchique : Nadine Locoge (IMT NE)
Responsable fonctionnel : Dr. Aude Bourin (IMT NE), Prof. Alexandre Tomas (IMT NE), et Prof. Maurice Millet (Université de Strasbourg)
Catégorie :
Nature de l’emploi : Doctorat
Lieu de travail : Strasbourg / Douai
Contexte :
Le doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration scientifique entre le Centre d’Enseignement, Recherche et Innovation Energie Environnement (CERI EE) d’IMT Nord Europe et l’UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA : ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l’Energie, l’Environnement et la Santé) dont l’objectif est de renseigner l’influence des pluies sur les dépôts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des données existantes dans l’air ambiant.
L’IMT Nord Europe est une école sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique. IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.
IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.
Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».
Le CERI EE d’IMT Nord Europe développe des activités au cœur des transitions énergétiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orientée vers les sciences de l'atmosphère, la qualité des environnements intérieurs et les enjeux de l’efficacité énergétique et de la décarbonation. La candidate/le candidat intégrera l’un des 3 axes thématiques du CERI EE, l’axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosphériques).
Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École : www.imt-nord-europe.fr et celui du CERI EE https://recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr/energie-environnement-ceri
L’ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Procédés pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Santé, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l’Université de Strasbourg) a été créé en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des matériaux, surfaces et procédés pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ingénierie des polymères pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), décident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois équipes du LIPHT et les sept équipes du LMSPC ont été structurées en trois départements de recherche : catalyse et matériaux, chimie moléculaire et analytique, ingénierie des polymères.

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB
The Post Transition Coordinator - QP (Post TC) is responsible for providing proactive intervention and coordination of services and resources to persons residing in & maintaining their home or wish to be rehoused as part of the Transitions to Community Living (TCL) program. The Post TC must understand the Olmstead Act and embrace the housing first model. The Post TC must enjoy problem-solving, can adapt to changing circumstances, adjust plans easily, be willing to change your approach or perspective when needed, and be able to work in a fast-paced environment to maintain a caseload.
Post Transition activities support individuals with maintaining their home in the community setting. They assist with promoting community inclusion, employment, and ensuring the appropriate level of services and supports are in place to ensure ongoing tenancy for the individual.
These services support members/recipients with maintaining a home in the community of their choice. This is a remote position with work being completed in home/Vaya Partners office. The Post Transition Coordinator will coordinate services/supports via Vaya Partners technology, in collaboration with internal/external stakeholders.
Note: This position requires access to, and use of confidential healthcare information or protected health information (PHI) as described in laws addressing patient confidentiality, including, but not limited to, the federal HIPAA law, the Confidentiality of Alcohol and Substance Abuse Patient Records law, 42 CFR Part 2, and various state laws. As such, the individual filling this position shall be required to be trained regarding such laws and shall be required to observe those laws in his/her capacity as an employee of Vaya Partners. The individual filling this position shall also sign a confidentiality statement as an employee of Vaya Partners.
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
Post Transition Planning
The Post TC supports members/recipients after they have moved into their unit. The Post TC’s main objective is to, in partnership with the member/recipient’s behavioral health provider and care management, successfully retain participants in their community. After thirty (30) days of a member/recipient’s transition into their TCL home, the participant is assigned to the Post TC for continued support. The Post TC utilizes the Post Transition Stratification that specifies triggers to stratify members/recipients in either high, medium, or low categories. The stratification category directs the goals and subsequent tasks the Post TCs complete with providers to support the member/recipient. Each member/recipient is identified as low stratification to start and once they meet certain stratification criteria they are escalated to medium or high stratification and opened to the T&H Separation Risk program and/or the T&H Rehousing program. This triggers a staffing at the Pre-Separation Huddle until the criteria is resolved returning them back to a low stratification and the T&H Separation Risk program closes.
Rehousing
The Post TC supports members/recipients desire to be rehoused, rather the member/recipient is at risk of losing housing their current placement or has the desire to move to a new location. The Post TC goal is to reduce or prevent separations by rehousing the member/recipient when possible. Members/recipients who are at risk will collaborate with the provider(s) to alleviate issues to help keep them housed. According to the service definition, the provider(s) supports participants with identifying other housing options when they are losing their current residence and need to move to another location. What you'll do

What you'll bring

- Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers, understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships, plus the ability to develop that muscle in others.

- Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills

Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige woningbouwprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid. Dit wordt jouw baan Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke woningbouwontwikkelingen en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling. Wat ga je doen Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie. · &n

title: Integration/Test Automation Engineer (Journeyman)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks an Integration/Test Automation Engineer to build and maintain automated regression, API, integration, and load tests for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role creates repeatable automated test coverage, maintains representative test data, integrates test execution with CI/CD pipelines, and produces reproducible results and objective verification evidence.
The Integration/Test Automation Engineer works with software developers, API and integration engineers, functional testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, CI/CD engineers, operations teams, and Government stakeholders. The position helps identify defects earlier, improves regression coverage, validates interfaces and data exchanges, and provides reliable quality feedback throughout the software-development lifecycle.
This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Integration/Test Automation Engineer will:

• Design, develop, execute, maintain, and improve automated software tests.

• Build automated regression suites covering critical application capabilities and mission workflows.

• Develop API tests that validate requests, responses, schemas, authentication, authorization, error handling, and business rules.

• Develop integration tests that validate interfaces, adapters, services, data exchanges, dependencies, and end-to-end processing.

• Develop load and performance tests to evaluate throughput, response time, concurrency, resource utilization, stability, and failure behavior.

• Translate requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface specifications, data mappings, and technical designs into automated test coverage.

• Maintain traceability among automated tests, requirements, interfaces, defects, and release content.

• Design and maintain representative test data for positive, negative, boundary, exception, and high-volume scenarios.

• Develop repeatable processes for test-data creation, setup, masking, refresh, reset, reconciliation, and cleanup.

• Protect sensitive data and use approved synthetic, masked, or controlled test data.

• Integrate automated tests into approved continuous-integration and continuous-delivery pipelines.

• Configure appropriate triggers, quality gates, result thresholds, notifications, and failure conditions.

• Ensure automated tests provide timely and actionable feedback to development, testing, integration, and operations teams.

• Maintain automated execution across development, integration, test, staging, and other approved environments.

• Improve test reliability by identifying and correcting unstable, inconsistent, environment-dependent, or non-deterministic tests.

• Produce complete and reproducible test results, logs, reports, metrics, and objective evidence.

• Document test configurations, dependencies, data conditions, execution procedures, expected results, and known limitations.

• Analyze failed tests and distinguish product defects from test-script, test-data, environment, configuration, or dependency issues.

• Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, evidence, and affected requirements.

• Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, correction verification, and regression testing.

• Coordinate with API and integration engineers to validate service contracts, mappings, schemas, data transformations, and interoperability.

• Coordinate with CI/CD engineers to improve automated execution, artifact retention, test reporting, and pipeline reliability.

• Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to validate security corrections and integrate approved security testing where applicable.

• Support Government demonstrations, user acceptance testing, release testing, and operational validation.

• Provide automation coverage, execution status, defect

title: Jr. Casting Talent
description:
About High Scale
We’re High Scale - a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition-that’s the DNA behind everything we do.
Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026-and we need a Jr. Casting Talent specialist who can hunt down the fresh faces, authentic voices, and charismatic creators that define our brands.
Why This Role Matters
The people in front of the camera often determine whether an ad succeeds or fails. As a Junior Casting Talent Coordinator, you'll help discover the creators, actors, and everyday people who make audiences stop scrolling.
This is an entry-level opportunity for someone who lives on social media, has a great eye for authentic personalities, and wants to learn how performance-driven casting works. You'll work alongside experienced producers and casting specialists who will teach you how to identify winning talent and build lasting creator relationships.
What You’ll Do

• Scout New Talent

• Search Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and creator platforms to discover emerging talent.

• Reach out to creators and introduce them to High Scale opportunities.

• Help build a diverse roster of actors, UGC creators, influencers, and real-person talent.

• Assist in sourcing talent that matches client briefs and campaign goals.

• Support the Casting Process

• Review creator profiles and submitted videos.

• Help organize auditions and casting calls.

• Schedule interviews and communicate with talent throughout the process.

• Learn how to evaluate on-camera presence and authenticity.

• Build Creator Relationships

• Respond quickly and professionally to creator questions.

• Help brief talent on project expectations and timelines.

• Coordinate schedules and collect required materials.

• Support negotiations and usage rights under guidance from senior team members.

• Keep Our Talent Database Organized

• Maintain accurate creator profiles and contact information.

• Tag talent by demographics, interests, style, and specialties.

• Ensure our casting database stays current and easy to search.

Who You Are

• Social Media Obsessed

• 0-2 years of experience in recruiting, influencer marketing, casting, customer success, talent coordination, social media, or a related field.

• You spend time on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube and naturally notice creators before they become mainstream.

• You enjoy discovering new people and trends.

• Eager to Learn

• You don't need years of casting experience-we're looking for curiosity, hustle, and coachability.

• You're comfortable receiving feedback and improving quickly.

• You're excited to build a long-term career in creative production or influencer marketing.

• Great With People

• Strong English communication skills.

• Friendly, professional, and confident when reaching out to creators.

• Organized and dependable when managing multiple conversations.

• Detail-Oriented

• Comfortable using spreadsheets or similar tools (or willing to learn).

• Able to stay organized while juggling multiple projects.

• Reliable with deadlines and follow-through.

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and grow into a Senior Casting Director or Producer role.

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world-one perfectly cast role at a time.

On a day-to-day basis, this individual will be responsible for administrating and implementing database solutions while providing system operational support, administration, problem resolution, and perform software installations and upgrades on our database systems concentrating on Google Cloud Platform and other cloud-based solutions (up to 30%). The Database Administrator will be expected to exhibit strong troubleshooting techniques while striving to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Other duties also include monitoring performance and capacity on our database systems.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

• Responsibility for all enterprise database technology deployed in the cloud including various versions of Microsoft SQL Server and other database platforms including features such as the core database engine, reporting, data loading and transformations, business intelligence, replication technologies and other modules. Perform configuration and maintenance of database platforms, including patching.

• Monitor database instances for performance, utilization, and capacity. Work with application teams when appropriate to address issues.

• Manage maintenance plans, backups, and automated jobs.

• Responsible for the database platform security model, including using Active Directory-integrated accounts in a multi-forest environment where appropriate.

• Responsible for query writing and optimization.

• Responsible for database schema design.

• Develop, administer, and optimize Google BigQuery datasets, tables, views, partitioning, clustering, permissions, scheduled queries, and data pipelines to support reporting, analytics, and operational workloads.

• Responsible for advising report writers and their deployment in various reporting solutions or writing reports when needed.

• Support BigQuery SQL development, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, access controls, and integration with Google Cloud services, business intelligence tools, and enterprise data platforms.

• Use typical database, cloud, monitoring, and DevOps tools such as Google Cloud Console, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Dataflow, Dataproc, Looker, Tableau, SQL Server Management Studio, Visual Studio Code, Git, CI/CD release tools, PowerShell, Python, and ticketing or incident management platforms.

• Apply experience with AI agents and automation tools to improve database operations, including monitoring, incident triage, knowledge retrieval, documentation generation, operational workflows, and data-driven self-service capabilities.

• Responsible for performing traces and profiling to analyze and troubleshoot problems.

• Determine the best way to improve performance, whether through hardware adjustments, server configuration changes, or index and query changes.

• Understanding of software development methodologies, software development lifecycle management, and working in an Agile/SCRUM environment with software development teams, providing consultative advice on database design and query optimization, including indexes.

• Familiarity with DevOps tools for managing releases.

• Familiarity with code repository tools for managing SQL objects as code with version control.

• On-call support for after-hours issues required. Leverage automated alerting to be notified of issues as they happen. Tune alerts to reduce noise.

• Responds to incoming phone, email, or web-reported technical issues from internal users related to network and infrastructure, and assists in troubleshooting database issues as well as application issues for which the database may be a contributing factor.

• Identifies severity and impact and documents details in the Help Desk call tracking system.

• Performs database monitoring to ensure service level agreements are met and alert

title: Senior RF Engineer
locationText: Broomfield, Colorado, United States; Fort Collins, Colorado, United States
tags: Mission Systems : Battlespace Awareness Engineering : Battlespace Awareness Radar
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Senior RF Engineer

Location:  Broomfield, Colorado, United States; Fort Collins, Colorado, United States; Costa Mesa, CA, United States; Goleta, CA, United States

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Team

The Anduril Battlespace Awareness Radar team develops state-of-the-art radar systems, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies. The Radar team is seeking an experienced  Senior RF Engineer  to help us design, test, and deploy the next generation of US radars. The Radar team is responsible for all aspects of radar system development, from the ideation stage through initial production. In this role, you will work closely with an interdisciplinary technical team to define RF architectures, design, build, and test prototypes, and mature these prototypes into products.

About the Job

Anduril is seeking a Senior RF Engineer to build active electronically scanned arrays (AESAs) for radar applications across a range of frequency bands (depending on the program) - from architecture definition through hardware bring-up, field testing, and initial production. The team owns the full stack: antenna element design, RF front-end (RFFE) electronics, array integration, and the test infrastructure to verify it all. We move fast, hold high standards, and are looking for engineers who want their fingerprints on fielded systems.

What You'll Do

• Design : Own the RF design of analog beamforming AESA subsystems - incorporating T/R modules, beamforming ICs, corporate feed networks, and front-end filtering - for radar applications. Conduct trade studies, RF simulations, and prototyping to drive innovation and ensure optimal system performance. Lead design reviews and make architecture trade decisions across antenna, RFFE, and digital.

• Cross-Domain Collaboration : Work across antenna, digital, mechanical, and systems engineering to define array architectures that meet the needs of users in the field. Bake in design excellence, including DFM and DFT, so that our systems can support the warfighter for the long-haul.

• Test : Lead RF characterization of AESA hardware - including near-field antenna range measurements, RFFE performance mapping, and system-level radar mode verification. Own the troubleshooting process when hardware doesn't behave and drive root cause to closure.

• Teach : Mentor junior RF engineers on phased array fundamentals, measurement techniques, and design discipline. Set the standard for schematic quality, simulation rigor, and test documentation across the team.

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking an AI/ML Modeling Lead to support the United States Air Force (USAF) Rapid Sustainment Office (RSO) Condition Based Maintenance Plus (CBM+) program.

In this role, you will lead the modeling team in translating strategic vision into practical, data-driven solutions that treat data as a product. General Administration

Requirements

• Previous administration experience within a construction business or similar project-based environment.

• Experience managing a business Facebook page, job ads and enquiries.

title: Everything Engineer
description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.
About the Role
Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking an Everything Engineers" with a Backend focus to modernize a mission-critical legacy system managing billions of dollars in international security cooperation.

The Project

We’re working to modernize a mission-critical legacy system that manages foreign military sales cases for the U.S. government. It’s the system of record behind billions of dollars in international security cooperation. The legacy platform is a decades-old fat-client application with hundreds of screens, millions of lines of Java code, hundreds of thousands of lines of stored-procedure logic, hundreds of reports, and a ton of batch processing. It works. But we can do better for an important national security mission.

Our job is pretty straight forward. Out with the old, in with the new. We’re going to replace the legacy system with a modern web platform that does all the things; from a functional perspective, a technical perspective, and a compliance perspective. And we’re going to make it happen through quick iterations, built on an Agentic AI Software Development Lifecycle.

How we build (read this before applying)

AI-led development isn’t a novelty act, its just how software is built. Full stop. Every engineer on this team works through agentic toolkits, Codex/Claude Code/etc. Every day. On production code. Our engineering harness (versioned rules, skills, and specs that guide both humans and agents) is a first-class product with its own backlog. We measure ourselves on shipped, verified capability, not lines typed.

What that means in practice:

• You’ll decompose problems into specs precise enough that an agent can implement them directly and concretely, and you’ll own everything you merge, because agent output is your output.

• You’ll review rigorously. The bar is production software for a regulated federal financial system: test-driven development, human review on every merge, and a rigorous CI scans.

• You’ll ship constantly. Small reviewable changes, an always-green main branch, an always-on beta environment stakeholders can touch.

• You get to play with all the latest cool tech as part of your job.
If you think of AI-led development as vibe-coding, or some fad you tolerate between “real” coding sessions, this isn’t your team. If you’ve hand rolled enough code to appreciate how Agentic AI outsources all the tedious bits and lets you build anything, let’s talk.

What “Everything Engineer” means
Everybody builds across the whole stack (UI, API, database, infrastructure, pipeline) because our unit of work is a complete vertical slice of business capability, not a layer. You’ll have genuine breadth: you can stand up infrastructure, debug a pipeline, reason about security controls, and hold your own in any layer of the system. And you’ll have real depth in your focus area, where you set the technical bar for the team.

Your focus: Backend

You’ll own the heart of the rebuild: the domain model and services that replace decades of accumulated business logic.

•
Domain services in TypeScript/Node behind a REST API: case lifecycle state machines, document generation, pricing and payment-schedule calculation engines, workflow and milestone logic.

•
Business-rule archaeology. The legacy system’s rules live smeared across converted Java, PL/SQL packages, and database triggers. You’ll help extract them into an evidence-cited knowledge base, then reimplement them with tests that prove parity, including golden

title: Storyteller, New Media & Content
description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
The Role
We’re building a humanoid robot in public, one day at a time. Asimov’s story already lives across X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Discord. It’s told by our team and by a growing community of builders who take our open-source CAD and code and make wild things with it. We need someone to turn that raw material into stories people can’t stop watching.
As our New Media & Content Storyteller, you’ll own how Menlo and Asimov show up on screen. You’ll find the story inside an engineering week, shoot it, cut it, and ship it in a format native to every platform. You’ll work from the lab floor alongside our engineers and researchers, not from a brief, and your lead character is a working humanoid.
What You’ll Do

• Own Menlo ’s short-form and long-form video end to end, taking each story from a moment in the lab to a finished, platform-native piece that ships the same week

• Run our build-in-public series, turning daily progress across hardware, locomotion, and research into a narrative people follow day after day

• Shoot, edit, and publish across X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, adapting each story to how that platform actually works

• Find the story in the technical, working with engineers and researchers so a new gait, a firmware fix, or a policy breakthrough lands with a non-expert audience without dumbing it down

• Amplify our community by spotting what builders make with Asimov, remixing it, and giving them a stage

• Capture our demo nights, community talks, and launches, and turn each one into content that lives well beyond the event

• Grow the audience: track what works, test formats and hooks fast, and double down on what lands

• Shape Menlo ’s voice on camera and in writing, and build a library of footage, scripts, and assets the whole company can draw on

What We Look For

• You have a portfolio of video and social content that grew a real audience, whether for a brand, a product, or yourself

• You shoot and edit fast with whatever’s on hand, from a phone to a proper rig, in Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar

• You understand each platform natively, and you know why what works on TikTok fails on YouTube

• You’re genuinely curious about technology and robotics, and happy to ask engineers basic questions until the story clicks

• You write sharp hooks, scripts, captions, and threads

• You ship constantly and treat analytics as feedback, not judgment

• You use AI as a real collaborator in your creative workflow

Nice to Have

• Experience creating content for a hardware, deep tech, or developer-focused company

• An existing following on any platform

• Comfort on camera as a host or narrator

• Motion graphics, 3D, or animation skills in tools like After Effects or Blender

• A background in film, journalism, or documentary, especially covering science or engineering

• Experience working with creator and developer communities

Why Join Menlo

Most content roles are about making a product look exciting. Here, the product is a walking, open-source humanoid that gets better every week, and you’ll see every breakthrough before anyone else does. You’ll have room to experiment, an engineering team that builds in public by default, and a community already making content you can build on. If you want to tell the story of robots entering the world while it’s actually happening, come build it with us.

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll help Airwallex manage and improve the economics of card payments, with a focus on scheme fees and interchange across Visa and Mastercard. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance.

- Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution.

- Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions.

You’ll work from our London office three days a week.

Essentials

- Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

- Strong knowledge of card payment economics, particularly Visa and Mastercard interchange, scheme fees, transaction qualification and network rules.

- Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

- Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

- Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

- Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation.

- Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale.

- Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners.

Preferred

- Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks.

title: Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d)
description:
stellenausschreibung
Mit unserer Marke deinSchrank.de stehen wir für maßgefertigte Möbel „Made in Germany“. In unserer eigenen Produktion fertigen wir in Losgröße 1 und begeistern Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa - überwiegend über unsere digitalen Kanäle.
Unser Marketing bauen wir gerade neu auf. Ein zentraler Hebel für unser Wachstum ist eine konsequent getestete Customer Experience - vom ersten Besuch über die Planung im Konfigurator bis zur Bestellung. Dafür suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt - remote aus ganz Deutschland - eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Conversion Rate Optimization Manager (m/w/d) .
das erwartet dich

• Du verantwortest die Conversion-Optimierung unserer Online-Shops und baust ein systematisches Testprogramm auf, in dem dauerhaft Tests laufen.

• Du entwickelst Hypothesen aus Daten, Nutzerverhalten, Kundenfeedback und Wettbewerbsvergleichen und priorisierst sie in einem transparenten Backlog.

• Du konzipierst A/B-Tests, setzt Varianten KI-gestützt um - etwa Mockups, Texte und Layouts - und wertest sie statistisch sauber aus.

• Du optimierst unseren Online-Konfigurator, Produktseiten, Checkout und Landingpages und reduzierst gezielt Hürden und Abbrüche im Planungs- und Kaufprozess.

• Wo der Traffic für A/B-Tests nicht reicht, arbeitest du mit qualitativen Methoden wie Session-Analysen, Heatmaps und Nutzerbefragungen.

• Du dokumentierst Ergebnisse und Learnings in einem Testlog und stellst sie regelmäßig im Management und im Team vor.

• Du baust agentische Workflows für Analyse, Variantenentwicklung und Reporting auf.

• Du arbeitest eng mit Performance Marketing, CRM, Content, Design und unserer Webentwicklung zusammen.

das solltest du mitbringen

• Langjährige Erfahrung in der Conversion-Optimierung, idealerweise im E-Commerce, mit einer großen Zahl selbst verantworteter Tests

• Ein gutes Gespür dafür, welche Änderungen wirklich verkaufen - und nicht nur, was gut aussieht

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Testmethodik und Statistik, z. B. Signifikanz, Laufzeiten und Stichprobengrößen

• Sicherer Umgang mit Analyse- und Testing-Tools wie GA4, Microsoft Clarity oder gängigen A/B-Testing-Plattformen

• Ein ausgeprägtes UX-Verständnis; Webdesign-Kenntnisse sind ein Plus, Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich

• Eine starke KI-Affinität und Erfahrung darin, Mockups, Varianten und Analysen mit KI-Tools zu erstellen

• Durchsetzungsstärke und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse auch auf Management-Ebene überzeugend zu vertreten

• Erfahrung mit konfigurierbaren oder erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten ist von Vorteil

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Niederländisch ist ein Plus

• Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise; ein Wohnort im Raum Köln/Bonn ist ein Plus

das bieten wir dir

• Großen Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau unseres Testprogramms - inklusive der Freiheit, es mit KI-Agenten zu skalieren - und kurze Entscheidungswege

• Ein sicheres Arbeitsverhältnis mit einer fairen, leistungsgerechten Vergütung in einem wachstumsstarken, innovativen Unternehmen

• Moderne Tools und eine eigene KI-Infrastruktur für das Marketing

• 30 Urlaubstage und eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung

• Eine offene Kommunikationskultur, flache Hierarchien und ein familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld

• Eine gezielte Einarbeitung sowie Weiterbildung und Förderung deiner Entwicklung

• Rabatte auf unsere Möbel, „Family and Friends“-Angebote und weitere Mitarbeitervorteile

• Remote-Arbeit aus ganz Deutschland und regelmäßige Mitarbeiter-Events vor Ort

die nächsten schritte
Du willst unsere Shops messbar besser machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit zwei bis drei Beispielen aus deinen bisherigen Tests (Hypothese, Ergebnis, Learning), deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung - per E-Mail an
Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Issuing is the front door for Lithic and its customers’ card payments programs. Nearly every API interaction and card transaction traces back to a card or account created by a service the Issuing team owns. We can be the reason a launch is successful, a customer signs on or an end user takes up a payment card in their day-to-day life.

You’ll build and own the services that manage the entire lifecycle of cards and account holders, including card issuance, physical card manufacturing, digital wallet and agentic tokenization, as well as the KYB/KYC programs that keep our customers and bank partners safe. • Build and innovate in card and account lifecycle features

• Own initiatives from planning to launch, including working with stakeholders and demonstrating developer-first product design thinking

• Design APIs as products, thinking through the developer experience from endpoints to docs to error messages

• Build resilient, fault-tolerant systems with predictable failure modes and fast recovery

• Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across teams

• Participate in the team’s on-call rotation

• Write and operate production services in Python and Rust on AWS

What You’ll Bring:

• 4+ years of experience shipping code in fast-paced production environments

• Strong distributed systems design skills, including building high-availability, fault-tolerant services

• Experience building APIs that drive the product experience for external developers

• Sound judgment about what has to be right the first time and what can ship with a narrower scope and be iterated on later

• The ability to advocate for high-leverage work and weigh it collaboratively against near-term deadlines

• Experience in or desire to learn Rust

• Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve

• Previous experience in fintech (especially card payments) is a bonus

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced securities lawyer to join the Corporate Legal team as Corporate Counsel, Public Company Reporting & Governance. In this role, you will prepare our SEC filings, advise on securities law and corporate governance, and support the Board and its committees. You will also partner closely with finance, accounting, investor relations, and equity teams to build the systems, controls, and repeatable processes that accurate, timely disclosure depends on. 

This is a hands-on role with meaningful scope and visibility. You will provide strategic, practical advice to senior leaders and teams across the company. You will draft and review disclosure yourself, while also helping build the processes and workflows that allow the function to scale.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare and review SEC filings, including Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, the proxy statement and Section 16 filings

• Advise on compliance with SEC and Nasdaq rules

• Help establish and run our disclosure controls and procedures, including the disclosure committee and the reporting calendar

• Support our securities compliance policies and the administration of the Insider Trading Policy, including trading windows, pre-clearance and 10b5-1 plans

• Review earnings materials, press releases, investor presentations and other significant external and internal communications

• Partner with Investor Relations on Regulation FD compliance, stockholder engagement and the annual meeting

• Prepare Board and committee materials, draft minutes and resolutions, and maintain governance policies and committee charters

• Support executive and equity compensation disclosure with the People and Equity teams

• Advise the teams that report publicly on our mission and safety work

• Keep partner teams informed of governance trends and SEC and Nasdaq developments

• Contribute to the processes and tools that let a small team handle public company work at scale

Minimum Qualifications

• Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you’ll be based (California or New York preferred)

• Significant public company reporting experience. This role is focused on periodic reporting and governance, and is not a capital markets or M&A role

• Deep knowledge of corporate and securities law, including SEC and Nasdaq rules

• Experience giving accurate, practical advice in real time at a fast-growing company

• A working understanding of accounting and corporate finance

• A track record of building strong working relationships across teams

• Clear written and verbal communication with executives and non-lawyers, without legal jargon

Preferred Qualifications

• At least 8 years of relevant legal experience, including securities and corporate governance experience at a law firm and in-house at a public company

• Experience building processes and procedures to public-company standards

• Experience supporting a public company board and its committees

• A track record of standing up a process or program 

• The ability to translate securities law requirements into clear, practical guidance for business teams

• Sound judgment and the ability to advise with incomplete information
